rules.statement: A court has the power to order delivery of possession to a purchaser who bought property sold in execution of a decree for its sale under the Partition Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "The powers given to the Court by the Ordinance are very extensive. It is empowered to issue a commission for the sale of the property. The property is sold by the court, and after payment of the purchase money by the purchaser to Court a certificate is delivered to him by the Judge, narrating she fact of the sale, setting forth his name, and the fact that he has said the purchase money to Court. This certificate constitutes a complete title to the property without any necessity of a deed of transfer and combined with the decree for sale it is, by virtue of section 9, a title good against the world."
